-"""Request handlers."""\r\n\r\nimport os\r\nfrom pathlib import Path\r\n\r\nfrom app.services import users\r\n\r\n_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _is_valid_relative_dir(raw: str) -> bool:\r\n    """Return True when raw is a '/'-separated relative path of safe segments.\r\n\r\n    The empty string refers to the data directory itself. Any other path is\r\n    valid only when every segment is non-empty and is neither "." nor "..".\r\n    """\r\n    if raw == "":\r\n        return True\r\n    return all(segment not in ("", ".", "..") for segment in raw.split("/"))\r\n\r\n\r\ndef handle_dir_size(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:\r\n    raw = params.get("dir", "")\r\n    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not _is_valid_relative_dir(raw):\r\n        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}\r\n\r\n    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()\r\n    try:\r\n        target = (base / raw).resolve()\r\n    except (OSError, ValueError):\r\n        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r\n    if not target.is_relative_to(base):\r\n        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}\r\n    if not target.is_dir():\r\n        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r\n\r\n    total = 0\r\n    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(target):\r\n        for name in files:\r\n            entry = Path(root) / name\r\n            try:\r\n                if entry.is_file():\r\n                    total += entry.stat().st_size\r\n            except OSError:\r\n                continue\r\n    return 200, {"bytes": total}\r\n\r\n\r\ndef handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:\r\n    raw = params.get("id")\r\n    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():\r\n        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}\r\n    user = users.get_user(int(raw))\r\n    if user is None:\r\n        return 404, {"error": "not found"}\r\n    return 200, user\r\n+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def _is_valid_relative_dir(raw: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True when raw is a '/'-separated relative path of safe segments.
+
+    The empty string refers to the data directory itself. Any other path is
+    valid only when every segment is non-empty and is neither "." nor "..".
+    """
+    if raw == "":
+        return True
+    return all(segment not in ("", ".", "..") for segment in raw.split("/"))
+
+
+def handle_dir_size(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("dir", "")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not _is_valid_relative_dir(raw):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    try:
+        target = (base / raw).resolve()
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    if not target.is_relative_to(base):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    if not target.is_dir():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    total = 0
+    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(target):
+        for name in files:
+            entry = Path(root) / name
+            try:
+                if entry.is_file():
+                    total += entry.stat().st_size
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+    return 200, {"bytes": total}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def _is_valid_relative_dir(raw: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True when raw is a '/'-separated relative path of safe segments.
+
+    The empty string refers to the data directory itself. Any other path is
+    valid only when every segment is non-empty and is neither "." nor "..".
+    """
+    if raw == "":
+        return True
+    return all(segment not in ("", ".", "..") for segment in raw.split("/"))
+
+
+def handle_dir_size(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("dir", "")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not _is_valid_relative_dir(raw):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    try:
+        target = (base / raw).resolve()
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    if not target.is_relative_to(base):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    if not target.is_dir():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    total = 0
+    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(target):
+        for name in files:
+            entry = Path(root) / name
+            try:
+                if entry.is_file():
+                    total += entry.stat().st_size
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+    return 200, {"bytes": total}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
